footer.tagline: 100+ student groups. One city. One tool.

landing.label: For student groups
landing.title: Your group on FOMO
landing.text: Register your student group and keep its profile up to date here. First-year students then find you through the quiz and the directory on the FOMO website.

register.title: Register a group
register.text: Your group isn't listed yet? Registration is free and takes ~15 minutes.

edit.title: Edit your profile
edit.text: Open your edit link – you can use it to update your profile at any time. Lost your link or never got one? Request a new one here.

request.notListed: Your group isn't listed? <register>Register it instead.</register>
request.hint: We send the link to the contact address stored for your group. If it has changed, briefly tell us who you are.
request.fallback: The group list could not be loaded. Just write to <mail>{email}</mail>.

mail.subject: Edit link for {group}
mail.body:
Hello FOMO team,

we would like to edit the profile of our student group "{group}" ({url}). Please send us a new edit link.

My role in the group: 

Best regards

request.copied: Copied – now paste it into your mail program
request.copyFailed: Copying didn't work – select the text below and copy it yourself.

site.title: To the FOMO website
site.text: Quiz and directory of all student groups.

selfrating.noToken: No invitation link found. Please use the link from your email.
selfrating.title: Group check

intro.text: Please answer the following 21 statements from the perspective of your group. Imagine a typical member is speaking:
intro.quote: "Members of our group would agree with this statement."
intro.duration: This takes about 5 minutes. Your answers will be used directly as the matching profile for the FOMO quiz.

filter.label: Activities
filter.title: Which activities are central to your group?

item.memberWouldAgree: Members of our group would agree:

description.title: Group info
description.text: Fill in your group's information — the more complete, the better the matching.
description.shortDescPlaceholder: What makes your group special? What do you offer new members?
description.longDescPlaceholder: What exactly do you do, when do you meet, how can people join?
description.longDescHint: Shown on your profile page. Leave empty for no detailed description.

raterCount.question: How many people worked together on the answers?

errors.validation: Please check the fields marked in red.
errors.shortDescription: The short description must be 10–200 characters long.
errors.longDescription: The detailed description can be at most 3,000 characters long.
errors.contactEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.websiteUrl: Please enter a valid web address, e.g. your-group.org.
errors.instagramUrl: Please enter your Instagram name (e.g. @your.group) or an Instagram link.
errors.memberCount: Please enter a member count between 1 and 10,000.
errors.foundedYear: Please enter a founding year between 1900 and today.

done.title: Profile saved!
done.textLive: Thank you! Your changes are saved. They will appear on www.fomo-dresden.app the next time the FOMO team updates the website – usually within a few days. You can reuse your link for later changes.
done.textReview: Thank you! Your profile is saved. The FOMO team will take a quick look; after that it appears on www.fomo-dresden.app – usually within a few days.
